counterevidence_considered.description: A potential objection: the report mentions the complete design of 10 planned stations, which could be read as invoking a complete domain. However, this line is descriptive accounting only; the declared scientific target and the selected result are both explicitly the retained subset, so no quantity is claimed for the complete planned set.

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to find any claim in the report that attributes a quantity to the complete planned set of 10 stations while computing on the 8 retained stations. The only rate claim in the report is line 11, which is explicitly scoped to the 8 retained stations, and line 9 disclaims applicability to the complete planned set. The arithmetic 6/8 = 75.0 matches the claim's own stated domain. The in-scope issue requires a complete-domain claim backed by a subset computation; no complete-domain claim exists here, so the falsification attempt failed.
